title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
Cloud Kicks want to track the return on investment (ROI) of its marketing campaigns for trade shows and customer webinars.
What should the consultant recommend?
option_A: Use the Primary Campaign Source field on the Opportunity object.
option_B: Enable Campaign Influence and add It to the Opportunity page layout.
option_C: Create a custom field on the Opportunity object to capture Campaign details.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
Access to Opportunities at Cloud Kicks should be restricted.
Sales users should only have access to two categories of Opportunities:
* Opportunities they own
* Opportunities that are tied to accounts they own
Which action should a consultant take to meet the requirement?
option_A: Set organization-wide defaults for Accounts and Opportunities to Private.
option_B: Set organization-wide defaults for Accounts and Opportunities to Public Read- Only.
option_C: Set Opportunity access on the role to View All Opportunities associated with the owner's accounts.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
During a discovery session at Cloud Kicks, a major topic is highlighted that is outside the current statement of work (SOW). The addition to the project scope is necessary but will be difficult to implement.
How should the consultant proceed?
option_A: Create a change request for the new items.
option_B: Revise the timeline to accommodate the new Items.
option_C: Conduct another discovery session to define the new items.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
A consultant for Cloud Kicks is migrating data from an on-premises system to Salesforce. The consultant has imported Account records, and is attempting to import the associated Contacts using Data Loader, but the import has failed records. The error messages all read UNABLE TO LOCK ROW.
What is causing these records to fail?
option_A: Updates to child records that have the same parent records are being processed simultaneously.
option_B: Contact records should be imported in the same batch as Account records.
option_C: An Apex trigger on the Account object is firing on insert and causing the Contact import to fall.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
In a recent management meeting, the VP of sales voiced concern over the current economic environment. To better understand the effectiveness of its marketing efforts, the VP expressed a need to monitor and reduce churn going forward.
Which strategy should a consultant recommend to address the VP's concern?
option_A: Create a year over year sales by Account report.
option_B: Create an average stage duration by Opportunity report.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
Cloud Kicks (CK) has recently lost several large deals to a competitor. CK management wants to start tracking the reasons why opportunities are being lost.
What is the most efficient way for a consultant to meet this requirement?
option_A: Create a Competitors channel in Slack to share insights and stories.
option_B: Create a new custom object and automation to track competitors.
option_C: Create a new custom field on the Opportunity object.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Sales-Con-201 exam
question:
Universal Containers is in the planning phase of its Sales Cloud implementation. In a recent discussion, the CEO expressed a desire to measure the return on investment (ROI) of its sales and marketing efforts by location.
Which solution should the consultant recommend?
option_A: Track total opportunity pipeline by lead source and location.
option_B: Track total accounts created by lead source and location.
option_C: Track total cases submitted by lead source and location.
